title: docs/site: next 16.4.1 security bump
byline: sec-next-1 lane · Claude Opus 5.5 via Claude Code · exposure read is read only

verdict.say: docs/site moves from next 16.3.8 to 16.4.1, which patches 2 critical and 1 high advisory. A read of the code found no use of the three vulnerable paths, so this is defense in depth, not an incident.
verdict.how: npm view and the vercel/next.js advisories for versions; npm provenance for the release; a read only grep of docs/site for use cache, the images config and server actions

kpis.l: sharp in the lock (GHSA-2464 fix floor)

health.title: Exposure of docs/site, by advisory
health.caption: Exposure is judged on the base code; the bump closes all three either way.

changes.title: next ^16.3.8 to ^16.4.1 in docs/site/package.json
changes.why: 16.0.0 to 16.4.0 is affected by GHSA-673q-mjm6-r5xr, GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw, GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r.

changes.title: Keep the sharp ^0.35.5 override
changes.why: GHSA-2464 names sharp >=0.35.5 as the fix; the existing override already sets that floor.

changes.title: Pin the Sanity project id in images.remotePatterns
changes.why: The pattern allows any Sanity project under /images/**. It matters only if SVG were ever allowed. Hardening note, not in this PR.

lenses.name: A · use cache
lenses.finding: 0 real directives; the only hits are prose inside generated strings. No cacheComponents or useCache in next.config.mjs.

lenses.name: B · image optimizer
lenses.finding: No dangerouslyAllowSVG; all 7 Image sources are png or jpg; deploy is Vercel (vercel.json). That Vercel runs its own optimizer is a guess.

lenses.name: C · server actions
lenses.finding: App Router present, 0 use server files, 0 form actions.

lenses.name: Release provenance
lenses.finding: next@16.4.1 carries SLSA v1 provenance from vercel/next.js refs/tags/v16.4.1, build_and_deploy.yml.

caveats: The exposure read is a subagent grep of the tree, not a build or a live probe.
No local build or tests ran. CI is the judge.
No glyph mockup was approved for this page; it uses the approved page-kit audit layout as is.
